item.title: Great screened in porch! Sears Kit House! C. 1918 in Louisiana. $199,500
item.description: I love the screened in porch! This is a Sears Craftsman Bungalow. The house was built in 1918. It is located on .43 acre in Minden, Louisiana. The house could use some updating and undoing of previous renovations. The house features a covered front porch, a screened in porch, wood floors, coffered ceiling, built-in bookshelves, pocket doors, french doors, wainscoting, baseboards and vintage tiled bathrooms. There is a detached garage on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,837 squar

item.title: Lake house in Maine! So quaint! Circa 1950. $375,000
item.description: This sure is a quaint looking house! This lakefront house was built in 1950. It is located on .38 acre in Northfield, Maine. The house features a large side patio, wrap around patio, enclosed porch, wood floors, wainscoting, knotty pine, corner cabinet and chair rails. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,174 square feet. $375,000 Contact Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate/The Masiello Group: nballrealestate@gmail.com From the Zillow listing: Two-story, move-in ready, Fulton Lake, 3 bedroom, 1.

item.title: Tennessee’s most expensive old house listing! Pinewood Farm, 582 acres. $11,995,000
item.description: Welcome to Tennessee’s most expensive old house listing! Pinewood Farm is a legacy property! It was established in 1850. It is located on 582 acres in Nunnelly, Tennessee. This farm has been a successful cattle farm. There are rolling pastures, hardwood forests and ponds. There are two creeks, five ponds, a fruit orchard, main family house and a one bedroom guest cottage. The farm is one hour from Nashville. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,788 square feet. $$11,995,000 From the Zillow listi

item.title: Pretty setting! Circa 1898. Two acres in Maryland. $399,999
item.description: This house has a pretty setting and nice curb appeal. The house was built in 1898. It is located on 2.04 acres in Street, Maryland. The house could use some updating, but it is nice. The house features a covered front porch, nice curb appeal, pretty setting, original wood floors, nice staircase, crown moulding and a spacious kitchen. There is a large basement and a detached garage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,436 square feet. $399,999 Contact Timothy Hopkins with Streett Hopkins Real Esta

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! On 2 1/2 acres in Massachusetts. $195,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! Even though this needs work, it is a decent price for Massachusetts. The house was built sometime in the mid 1800’s. It is located on 2.5 acres in Ewing, Massachusetts. The house features a covered front porch, wide plank wood floors, baseboards and bay windows. The back of the property is on Millers River. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,664 square feet. $195,000 Contact Alayna Zellmann with Ruggers Real Estate: 413-824-0184 From the Zillow listing: This1600 square foot, s

item.title: Great bookshelves! Pretty stained glass! Circa 1920 in Virginia. $169,900
item.description: Love all of those bookshelves! Pretty stained glass! The house was built in 1920. It is located in Covington, Virginia. The house features a covered wrap around front porch, original wood floors, pretty stained glass, nice staircase, bead board wainscoting, pocket doors, chair rails, french doors and crown moulding. There is a detached garage on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,776 square feet. $169,900 Contact Dominika Williams with Highlands Realty and Associates: 540-960-3234

item.title: Pretty views!! Great area! Over an acre in Virginia. $272,000
item.description: This is in a beautiful area! Not far from Hungry Mother State Park which has great hiking! Love the view from the front porch of this house! The home was built in 1914. It is located on 1.23 acres in Marion, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, great views, original wood floors, baseboards, picture rails, built-in china cabinet and original mantels. There is a detached garage and raised garden beds on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,571 square feet. $272,000 Conta

item.title: Fruit trees and outbuildings! On 2 1/2 acres in Michigan. $299,900
item.description: Multiple fruit trees! Multiple outbuildings! This property has a lot of potential! The house was built in 1920. It is located on 2.5 acres in Perry, Michigan. The house features a covered front porch, spacious kitchen, large wood burning fireplace, vaulted ceiling, wainscoting and there is a great kitchen sink. The property has apple, peach, grapes and raspberries. There is also a hot tub on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,982 square feet. $299,900 Contact Jack Walker with Ameri

item.title: Love the roof and old call box! 4,500 square feet in Minnesota. $324,900
item.description: I love the roof on this house! The old servant call box is pretty cool too! This high style Arts and Crafts/Tudor Revival house was built in 1912. It is located on .35 acre in Austin, Minnesota. The house features a dramatic rolled cedar shingle roof, which was designed to mimic Old World thatch. Inside there is rich original woodwork, exposed beams, leaded glass doors, built-ins and period finishes. There is a picture of the old servant call box. item.title: Diamond in the Rough! C. 1938. On 2 1/2 acres in Mississippi. $125,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! The price is very reasonable. The house was built in 1938. It is located on 2.5 acres in Aberdeen, Mississippi. The brick house features wood floors, picture rails, baseboards, built-in shelving, crown moulding and a nice staircase. There is a carport on the property and mature trees. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,580 square feet. $125,000 Contact Bill Strauss with Coldwell Banker Frady and Associates: 662-574-0720 From the Zillow listing: Charm
